LanguageData.WWBCE_Intro: Adjust the CE carrying bonuses granted by each Wolfein weapon box. Vanilla carrying capacity and the item's own mass and bulk are unchanged.
LanguageData.WWBCE_Note: Range: 0–1000, step 1. Changes apply immediately, including to already worn boxes. Settings are saved when this window closes. Lowering capacity may cause overload; CE may drop excess items.
LanguageData.WWBCE_Inactive: Inactive: enable Combat Extended and Wolfein Race. Settings can still be saved. If both are enabled, check the startup log.
